title: Insurance as a hidden force in affordable housing
discussion_signal: The post argues that rising insurance costs can enter housing through higher rents, additional fees, deferred maintenance, or decisions about what gets built. It makes insurance a place-and-housing stability mechanism rather than a separate financial product.
linked_research_question: How insurance availability and price convert climate and property risk into rent, maintenance, construction, and mobility pressure.
limits: Professional post is an argument, not a verified causal estimate
